acceptance: A 2,000-row conversation draws only the rows in view (never more than 120) and a followed transcript shows its end.
Answer Markdown shows raw HTML as text and keeps only safe links; a fence names its language and offers an icon-only Copy that copies its source.
A long answer first shows a bounded window (at most 240 blocks or 24 KiB) with Show full response, which opens the whole answer and offers to collapse it again.

reason: TS fades a newly committed row in once (and never replays it on rerender); the native transcript draws new rows without entrance motion.

acceptance: A prompt is one user row from admission through the native echo and completion, never repeated in the live tail; distinct submissions with identical text stay distinct.
Row gaps follow one rhythm: a settled summary's gap becomes a turn handoff when the next user turn arrives, and the next row moves to its new offset.
When rows reflow (a width change) the visible row keeps its viewport coordinate through one anchor, and a filtered anchor falls back to the nearest surviving row.

reason: TS virtualizes the transcript itself: it exposes an estimated canvas height until a ResizeObserver (border-box) reports, caches row sizes under a width/font layout signature across remounts, guards observer callbacks after unmount and keeps DOM nodes for identity through the first native binding. GPUI's list lays out and measures each visible row before painting and remeasures spliced rows; the native transcript keeps its ListState per mounted chat, with no size cache, observers or DOM nodes.

acceptance: The transcript draws no empty cue of its own; a ready empty chat shows the runtime's theme-coloured vector mark (Codex, Pi) that spins once per click and asks what to work on; a prompt in the live tail removes the cue.

reason: TS asserts its CSS grid (five regions, the overlay spanning conversation and dock rows, computed control sizes and cursors) and an optional surface header. The native panel stacks status, the conversation with its overlay and the dock in GPUI flex layout and has no header region; its geometry is checked by the pixel lab.

TS lets extensions register a renderer per part kind and restore the previous one on dispose. The native transcript renders a closed set of part kinds compiled into the app; there is no runtime renderer registry.

acceptance: A saved chat stays openable while its Agent needs sign-in; opening returns its target.
